entities.name: Arab-Byzantine Condominium
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The unique arrangement under which Cyprus was jointly governed by the Byzantine and Umayyad/Abbasid empires, sharing tax revenues — a rare example of medieval peaceful coexistence.
